dt_sweep.rationale: Static analysis — no time discretization. Marked stable as a sentinel value; not a temporal convergence claim.

mesh_sweep.rationale: 8 through-wall × 8 axial × 1 circumferential C3D20 elements on the L=400 mm cylinder at 20 MPa. Worst-case relative error vs Lame's analytical: σ_r ≤ 1.32%, σ_θ ≤ 0.14%, σ_z ≤ 0.20%, vM ≤ 0.25%. All comfortably below the 5% engineering tolerance applied for Tier 1 candidate scoping.
